# Integrated workflows
Twelve executable patterns are represented by the scripts in `handbook/scripts/`: construct memory cubes; read NetCDF; slice; crop; extract series; extract profiles; transects; events; masks; climatology/anomalies; 3-D geometry; and preparation for `spatind`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
A[External or local data] --> B[download_nc / read_nc]
B --> C[ocean_cube]
C --> D[cube_collect]
C --> E[cube_slice]
C --> F[cube_crop]
C --> G[cube_extract]
C --> H[cube_transect]
C --> I[link_events]
C --> J[cube_mask]
C --> K[cube_climatology / clim_day / clim_month]
K --> L[anom_diff / anom_z]
C --> M[cube_cell_area]
C --> N[cube_layer_thickness]
M --> O[cube_cell_volume]
N --> O
M --> P[cube_polygon_weights]
N --> P
G --> Q[spatind]
P --> Q
```
